_provenance.source_repository: external evaluation snapshot da580f9; compact values manually consolidated for this poster
_provenance.hdd: results/hdd_frozen_matrix.json -> cells[*].macro_map.macro_map; displayed paired contrasts are each alternative minus V-JEPA 2, not all pairwise comparisons
_provenance.vcdb: results/vcdb_frozen_matrix.json -> cells[*].readouts.bof.query_macro_ap (role=canonical); this public snapshot retains displayed point estimates only
_provenance.aria: docs/results/aria_row_complete.md (record of truth; the JSONs hold per-recording detail only)
_provenance.soccernet: Valid split, 6,376 same-half queries from 100 complete matches, unordered bidirectional Chamfer, match-macro MRR. DINOv3 and RADIO use 2 s / 1 s windows, eight frames per window at 448 px; V-JEPA 2 uses 16 frames and eight tubelet tokens per window at 256 px. Only these three displayed public arms have tracked results on the same valid population with the same scorer family.
_provenance.selection: The plot keeps five disclosure-approved configurations scored in HDD, VCDB, and Aria, plus two synthetic-copy-only configurations. SoccerNet-v2 is intentionally sparse: three displayed rows have tracked results on the same valid population and four were not run. Omitted row identities and results are not carried in this public artifact.
_provenance.excluded_arms: Non-public and author-excluded source rows are absent by design. Do not extend the public display without a fresh disclosure review. The two internal synthetic-copy configurations appear only under their public display labels.
_provenance.note_role: An external narrative snapshot and immutable scorecard artifact supply the separate DRT production-recipe scorecard. This file records a controlled frozen-matrix evaluation; neither result set supersedes the other.
_provenance.note: Compact snapshot of the controlled evaluation. Poster production-scorecard values live in production_scorecard.json and retain their own source hash and protocol descriptions.
_provenance.synthetic_copies: The values shown here agree with the corresponding DRT source cells, but belong to this controlled-evaluation summary only when explicitly plotted. Point estimates only -- no paired bootstrap exists for this cohort.
_provenance.production_scorecard_boundary: The DRT SoccerNet lane uses one normalized clip vector with cosine similarity; this file's SoccerNet lane uses window sequences with unordered bidirectional Chamfer on the valid same-half population. HDD, VCDB, and Aria also use different protocols across the two artifacts. Both evaluations are valid; do not transfer values, chance floors, intervals, or run-status claims between them.
_provenance.gaps: A null value means the cell was not run under that cohort protocol, not zero.
_provenance.qualification: These are configuration-level descriptive comparisons, not a controlled backbone ablation. Sampling density and resolution vary in HDD and VCDB; Aria also uses predeclared readouts that differ by cell. SoccerNet-v2 uses a separate valid-split Chamfer protocol and model-specific tokenization. The synthetic-copy, HDD, VCDB, SoccerNet-v2, and Aria columns are distinct protocols and their raw metric levels are not comparable across columns.
